scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,server "npm run dev -w @game/web" "npm run dev -w @game/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @game/core && npm run build -w @game/shared && npm run build -w @game/server && npm run build -w @game/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @game/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @game/core && npm run build -w @game/shared && npm run build -w @game/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @game/core && npm run build -w @game/shared && npm run build -w @game/server
